title: Floating point exception in torch.Tensor.mvlgamma_

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.description: Functions with no exact solutions, analogous to those in scipy.special

labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

test1.py
```python
import torch
print(torch.__version__)

tensor = tensor = torch.randint(low=0, high=10, size=(5,),dtype=torch.int64)

input = [[tensor,1024],{}]

torch.Tensor.mvlgamma_(*input[0],**input[1])
```
python test1.py
```
2.9.0.dev20250828+cu129
Floating point exception (core dumped)
```
